answer: A falcon-eyed agent economy resists sybils by requiring every identity to thread a live prism through the canyon of each epoch: the public beacon drops an unpredictable spectral challenge, and the agent must return a unique refraction signed against its own stake within minutes. Clones shatter because one pair of wings cannot sweep a thousand canyons at once; the prism reveals every cheap copy as a flat shadow. A farm pays the canyon's price a thousand times over, and the falcon simply watches the fakes fall.
